payload.summary: Decision on 2x semantics (Jim AFK, planner recommended, I accepted): 2x on an empty layout places the LAST bet doubled, not rebet-then-double. Decisive reason: playRound calls betLayout.clearAll() before settlement, so the layout is always empty when a player reaches for 2x after a round — under the x1 reading 2x would duplicate Rebet in the only state it is ever pressed from. Unaffordable doubling is refused outright and the button disables, never clamped or partially applied: a partial double silently changes which side you are backing, and a button labelled 2x that does not double is a lie. With neither current nor last bet, 2x disables and announces "No wagers to double." 2x is repeatable (4x, 8x) until the bankroll gate refuses. Keyboard X. Order Clear -> Rebet -> 2x -> DEAL in both visual and tab order, which pushes header and count-panel tabIndex up by one.
